name: Gym Rat
source:
When you joined the gym at the start of the new year, you never expected your heart to be getting the biggest workout...

GYM RAT is a game about finding your passions, on and off the running wheel. In this beta, you can take a step aerobics class and meet Norv (from [url=https://vndb.org/v43184]Coffee Break[/url]), a jovial older rat looking to supplement his love of bowling with something new.

[From [url=https://lumpyj.itch.io/gym-rat-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
